report_code <- lapply(seq_len(length(starts) - 1L), function(index) {
  section_lines(starts[[index]], starts[[index + 1L]])
})
names(report_code) <- names(starts)[seq_along(report_code)]
if (!is.logical(params$use_saved_results) || length(params$use_saved_results) != 1L ||

## Purpose and inputs

This repository-only analysis is provided for transparency and is not reported
in the manuscript or supplementary materials. It examines paired differences
using the existing 1,000 participant-cluster Bootstrap replications. The full
unthresholded networks are used throughout; case-dropping results and raw-p
support masks do not enter these comparisons.

The date above records the original analysis. The displayed result object's
execution time is `r report_result$created_at`.
`r if (params$use_saved_results) "This report displays saved results without recalculating differences or rewriting result files." else "This report recalculates the paired differences from saved Bootstrap estimates using the accompanying R implementation."`

Knit normally to calculate the differences and export their workbook. To render
only the saved results, use `params = list(use_saved_results = TRUE)` with
`rmarkdown::render()`. Neither mode reruns the upstream network or Bootstrap fits.
The accompanying `S6_8_APrioriBootstrapDifferenceTests.R` contains the complete
implementation; the sections below display its input and calculation code
without executing that code a second time.

```{r input-code, eval=FALSE, code=report_code$inputs}
```

## Interval interpretation

All differences are paired within each Bootstrap replication. The nominal
two-sided 99.9% percentile interval uses quantile type 6. With only 1,000
replications, its endpoints equal the observed minimum and maximum. Accordingly,
“Excludes zero” means that all stored paired differences have the same sign.
It is a conservative exploratory sign-stability summary, not an FDR-adjusted
test, a p value, or a fully resolved 99.9% confidence interval. Temporal
associations are conditional predictive associations, not causal effects.

```{r interval-code, eval=FALSE, code=report_code$definitions}
```

## Within-node target differences

Each of the 24 contrasts is Distress-target minus Engagement-target Bridge EI
for one PSMU manifestation and one network/direction. Positive values indicate
a larger signed value toward Distress within that metric.

```{r node-target-code, eval=FALSE, code=report_code$node_target}
```

<div class="table-scroll">

```{r node-target-results}
display_table("Node_Target",
  c("Contrast ID", "Network", "Bridge EI metric", "Node", "Estimate [99.9% CI]", "Bootstrap median", "Excludes zero"),
  c("ID", "Network", "Metric", "Node", "Difference [min–max envelope]", "Bootstrap median", "Excludes zero"))
```

</div>

## Core–Peripheral node differences

Each of the 64 contrasts subtracts a Peripheral node's signed Bridge EI from a
Core node's value, within the same target community and network/direction.
These are node-pair comparisons, not a difference between subgroup averages.

```{r core-peripheral-code, eval=FALSE, code=report_code$core_peripheral}
```

<div class="table-scroll">

```{r core-peripheral-results}
display_table("Core_Peripheral",
  c("Contrast ID", "Network", "Bridge EI metric", "Target community", "Core node", "Peripheral node", "Estimate [99.9% CI]", "Bootstrap median", "Excludes zero"),
  c("ID", "Network", "Metric", "Target", "Core node", "Peripheral node", "Difference [min–max envelope]", "Bootstrap median", "Excludes zero"))
```

</div>

## Prespecified Temporal edge-family differences

These six contrasts retain the S5.3 directions: mean Core-minus-Peripheral
prediction for Distress outcomes, and mean Peripheral-minus-Core prediction
for Engagement outcomes. The original S5.3 estimates are retained; this section
summarizes their paired participant-cluster Bootstrap distributions.

```{r temporal-edge-code, eval=FALSE, code=report_code$temporal_edge}
```

<div class="table-scroll">

```{r temporal-edge-results}
display_table("Temporal_Edge_Family",
  c("Contrast ID", "Outcome", "Contrast direction", "Estimate [99.9% CI]", "Bootstrap median", "Excludes zero"),
  c("ID", "Outcome", "Direction", "Difference [min–max envelope]", "Bootstrap median", "Excludes zero"))
```

</div>

## Result exports

The R implementation writes
`Res_3_Results/Table_S6_8_APrioriBootstrapDifferenceTests.xlsx` and
`Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/results_s6_8_apriori_bootstrap_difference_tests.rda`.
The workbook contains the three contrast families, with separate numerical columns for the differences, medians and interval endpoints. The RDA also keeps
the full paired-contrast matrices and input provenance.

```{r export-code, eval=FALSE, code=report_code$export}
```
